description: This is a unit test class for the JsonCharEscaper in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package, testing its escaping behavior for JSON characters, including control characters and special characters as per RFC 8259 section 7.

classes.name: JsonCharEscaperTest
classes.description: Unit test class for JsonCharEscaper, testing the escaping mechanisms for special characters and control characters in JSON strings.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test instance of JsonCharEscaper before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that JsonCharEscaper instances are immutable and their 'replacements' field is not modified.

methods.name: doNotEscapeNormalCharactersBeforeBackslash
methods.description: Ensures that normal characters (except quote and backslash) are not escaped by the escaper.

methods.name: escapeQuote
methods.description: Tests that the quote character is correctly escaped as \".

methods.name: escapeReverseSolidus
methods.description: Tests that the backslash character is correctly escaped as \\.

methods.name: escapeControlCharactersWithoutShorthands
methods.description: Ensures control characters not having shorthand escapes are encoded as Unicode escape sequences.

methods.name: escapeControlCharactersWithShorthands
methods.description: Tests that control characters with shorthands are escaped using those shorthands.

methods.name: minimalJsonString
methods.description: Validates that raw strings are correctly represented as JSON string values.
